verdict.rationale: Bitbucket's product page says CI/CD workflows can run on hosted runners with "no infrastructure needed" (docs-8), via the built-in Pipelines tool (docs-10, docs-18). This matches the core of the story. However, the evidence is only a marketing-level product page, with no technical documentation and no community or hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: detailed docs on hosted runner specs, limits and build minutes; independent or hands-on confirmation that hosted runners work as claimed.
